extensionDescription.message: Signs in to @bulbashenko.com mailboxes through auth.bulbashenko.com (OAuth 2.0 with PKCE).

optionsIntro.message: Thunderbird keeps a token so it does not ask you to sign in every time. Remove it to sign in again, for example with another account or after changing your password.

signOutPortal.message: Also sign out of $HOST$ in Thunderbird, so the next sign-in asks for a passkey or password

confirmClear.message: Remove the saved tokens? Thunderbird will ask you to sign in the next time it checks mail.

cleared.message: Tokens removed. Thunderbird will ask you to sign in the next time it connects.
